commits.messageBody:
…cleaned

Worktree cleanup (section 7C) is destructive — it deletes worktree
directories for merged/closed PRs. Previously it ran on every `atc health`
invocation, which could surprise users who just want a status check.

Now gated behind `auto_enabled` (--auto flag or health.auto_review config),
consistent with auto-remediation in section 7D.

Also skips records whose worktree directory no longer exists, avoiding
unnecessary GitHub API calls for already-cleaned entries.

commits.messageBody:
…fix auto-review BATS tests

Section 7B could re-trigger run_post_completion on NeedsReview→Done/Failed
transitions where the watcher already ran it. Add cost_usd.is_none() guard
as a proxy for "post-completion already ran".

Auto-review BATS tests were silently passing despite never actually testing
the code path: signal 2 (git ls-remote) errored in the test env because no
git repo existed at the worktree path, causing should_skip_transition to
return early with changed=false. Fix by creating a real bare git repo and
starting records in "running" status so the Running→NeedsReview transition
produces changed=true.
